verdict.rationale: Requesty is OpenAI-compatible and documents a router API (base_url swap, chat completions, images, PDFs, structured outputs, streaming) that AI-native users can drive programmatically, with quickstart docs and an llms.txt index confirming a documented API surface. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate OpenAPI paths returning 404) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
